string.text: Hold this key to transmit over the long-range walkie-talkie radio. Proximity voice is always active without pressing a key; pressing PTT nearby transmits both proximity and radio audio. Default: Z.
When enabled (default), every player always has an active walkie-talkie without needing any item in inventory.
Require Walkie-Talkie Equipped in Device Slot
Only used if "Always Have Walkie-Talkie" is disabled. When checked, a walkie-talkie must be equipped in slot 9; otherwise having one anywhere in inventory is enough.
Plays a subtle radio key click/beep inside the game when pressing or releasing the Push-to-Talk key. Disable if you only want the VOIP client's radio chirp.
